author: king process
description:
This Is How They’re Made! Korea’s Amazing Interactive Spaces!

Hello, this is King Process.
In this video, we take a look at two unique interactive spaces in Seoul: 63 Sky Picnic, newly created 250 meters above the city, and an AI experience space inside a traditional hanok in Ikseon-dong.
At 63 Building, the team installs the support structure and pedestals beneath the LED floor so it can safely hold large numbers of visitors. Lasers are used to level the entire surface, allowing the floor to become one massive screen. You can also watch the construction site transform into a special observation deck as mirrored ceilings and media art installations are added.
Next, we visit a hanok space in Ikseon-dong, where an AI shaman robot talks with visitors and gives fortune readings. We also meet Sketcher X, an AI robot that draws portraits of visitors.
Watch how two completely different spaces are transformed into new interactive destinations through technology and creative ideas.
